title: Carry Runs through an owner-host Remote Runtime
goal: After the local Runtime contract is qualified, carry the existing public ctxmux protocol through a system OpenSSH StreamLocal tunnel to an owner-host ctxmuxd while preserving remote lifecycle truth, exact Runtime and Run identity, reconnect and replay, owner-issued Stop receipts, and fail-closed mixed capabilities without adding Relay, accounts, a control plane, orchestration, or derivation metadata.
